    Your phone

    Pushes go through ntfy, a free app. No account: choose a topic, then subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy app.

    My server needs an access token

    Alerts

    One notification per check, listing only what is new. Alerts follow the filters you set on the Auto trades and Waiver wire pages.

    Trade ideasTrades that help both teams and beat a free pickup.
    Waiver pickupsFree agents who would start for you, with who to drop.
    Bench upgradesPlayers who would not start but clearly beat a bench player you never use. Same window as waiver pickups.
    CheckHow often Awaker looks for something new.
    Quiet hoursAnything found overnight arrives when they end. Same time twice turns them off.
